$comment: Written from crates/xenonet-model by cargo test -p xenonet-model. Change the type there, not this file.
title: A message frame's body
description: An entry of the sending machine's feed in the network, signed by its machine signing key, with the authority its act rests on; or that machine's ack of, or want for, the recipient's feed.

author.description: The author: its machine signing key, which the group's chain lists for a member

group.description: What a feed is scoped to: a network's net_ id or a space's spc_ id

inc.description: The author's incarnation: it changes only when the author's store was restored or it was set up again

seq.description: From 1 in each incarnation, kept and loose kinds each counted on their own

prev.description: On the first kept entry of an incarnation only: the last kept entry before it, or 0, 0

kind.description: What a feed entry is about: claims, intents, handoffs, assigns and reports are kept, in one gapless sequence per author and group; messages and receipts are loose, each taken once by its id

at.description: When the author made it, by its clock: shown, never a reason to drop it

body.description: What it says: network/send/v1 for a message, network/receipt/v1, network/handoff/v1

sig.description: The author's signature over xenonet-feed/1, a newline and the entry's canonical JSON without it

entry.description: One entry of a machine's feed in a group, a network or a space (xenonet-feed/1), signed by its machine signing key

token.description: For an act by an actor: a token its machine minted for this act (xenonet_actor_ and a Biscuit, base64url)

machine.description: The machine, by its host id

sig.description: The machine signing key's signature over it

root.description: The certificate of the token's root, which the receiver checks against the sending machine's signing key in the network's chain

person.description: A person's id: prs_ and 32 base32 characters

device.description: The device that signed, by its key's id

sig.description: The device's signature over the act's hash (xenonet-authz's act_hash), base64url; left out when the presence block stands for it

person.description: For an act as the person: their device, and its signature over the act unless the presence block stands for it

device.description: A signing key's id: xns1_ and 32 base32 characters

what.description: What a presence block approves: an Allow (answer), admitting a machine, widening a network's settings, publishing a service, a revocation, pairing a device, a delegation, or issuing or widening an actor's grant

act.description: The SHA-256 of the act, base64url

presence.description: For an act that needs the person there (an answer's Allow, an admit, a widening): a presence block for it

personHead.description: The head of the person's chain the sender held: a receiver with an older one asks for the rest

authority.description: For a message entry: what the act rests on, beside the entry since it's for this recipient alone
